name: Field Read-Only by Role
description: Marks fields editable for some roles and read-only for others, WITHOUT hiding them. SECURITY: enforcement is ONLY hook_form_alter setting #disabled — there is NO hook_entity_field_access — so the read-only restriction holds on the entity form UI but is BYPASSED by JSON:API/REST/Quick Edit/VBO/programmatic writes. It is a UI convenience, not a field-access control; don't rely on it to protect a field.
